summary.text: On Alara, a plane torn into five shards along color lines by an unknown planeswalker's plunder of its mana, each world develops in its own way, from Bant's ceremonial armies and Naya's Nacatl civil war to Esper's etherium crisis and Grixis, a hellish world ruled by undeath after Sedris became a lich.

Two planeswalkers drive the story: Ajani, who leaves Naya after his brother is killed and whose quest leads him to a face-to-face conflict with Nicol Bolas, and Tezzeret, who flees Esper's Academy, finds Bolas on Grixis and takes over his Consortium.
Bolas, losing his power after the Mending, plans to restore his glory and gain total power, and Sarkhan Vol ends up on his side.
